{
  "question_leaks_answer": false,
  "question_leak_note": "The question describes KPI changes but does not reveal the root‑cause category.",
  "evidence_supports_conclusion": "partial",
  "evidence_note": "KPI data clearly shows a traffic surge (large increase in packet counts and PRB utilisation) while radio quality remains flat, supporting a load increase. However, the claim of \"high network congestion\" is not substantiated because PRB utilisation stays very low (~1.5%).",
  "unsupported_claims_in_conclusion": [
    "High Network Congestion (Gradual Buildup) – utilisation remains far from saturation."
  ],
  "citations": [
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "5.1.1.2.1 DL Total PRB Usage",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Defines DL PRB utilisation measurement used to monitor radio‑layer load."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 28.552",
      "section": "5.1.1.2.2 UL Total PRB Usage",
      "role_claimed": "definition",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Defines UL PRB utilisation measurement."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "10.1 Basic Scheduler Operation",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "partial",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Describes that the scheduler allocates resources based on UE buffer status, implying that increased offered traffic leads to higher PRB usage, but does not explicitly state the causal chain."
    },
    {
      "spec_id": "3GPP TS 38.300",
      "section": "15.5.1.2 Load reporting for intra‑RAT and intra‑system inter‑RAT load balancing",
      "role_claimed": "mechanism",
      "passage_supports_explanation": "yes",
      "role_correct": true,
      "note": "Specifies that per‑cell PRB usage is the load indicator exchanged for load‑balancing decisions."
    }
  ],
  "has_adequate_mechanism_citation": true,
  "acceptable_conclusions_reasonable": true,
  "uncertainty_honest_and_complete": true,
  "uncertainty_missing": [],
  "verdict": "valid_with_changes",
  "required_changes": [
    "Remove or qualify the claim of \"high network congestion\" because PRB utilisation remains far below saturation.",
    "Clarify that the evidence points to a traffic surge causing a modest increase in load, not necessarily congestion.",
    "Optionally add a citation that directly links traffic volume increase to PRB utilisation (e.g., 3GPP TS 38.321 on MAC scheduling) to strengthen the mechanism argument."
  ],
